title: NEBNext Ultra II RNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina: Bead Purification of cDNA
author: Opentrons
materials: NEBNext Ultra II RNA Library Prep Kit

This protocol uses multi-channel P20 and P300 pipettes to perform library prep steps on 8-48 input total RNA samples according to the attached NEB user guide. This is part-3 of a six part process (bead purification of double-stranded cDNA). User-determined parameters are available to specify the number of samples and the magnet engage height and time. ---
The protocol will alert the user to ensure reagents are present on deck in sufficient volume.
The magnets will disengage for elution.
The magnets will engage to pellet the beads.

steps.title: Pre‑cool temperature module
steps.instruction: Set the temperature module in slot 1 to 4 °C using the OT app before starting the protocol.

steps.title: Verify reagent volumes
steps.instruction: Confirm that all reagents on the deck have sufficient volume as prompted by the protocol.

steps.title: Add beads and transfer
steps.instruction: Using the P300 multi‑channel pipette, add NEBNext Sample Purification Beads to each double‑stranded cDNA sample in the magnetic module plate, mix thoroughly, then transfer half of the reaction volume to the corresponding wells on the right side of the plate.

substeps.instruction: Add NEBNext Sample Purification Beads to each cDNA sample
Transfer half of the volume to the corresponding right‑side wells

steps.title: Incubate beads
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol and incubate the plate on‑deck for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Engage magnets, discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module to pellet the beads, then use the P300 multi‑channel pipette to remove and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash bead pellets
steps.instruction: Wash the bead pellets twice with 80 % ethanol using the P300 multi‑channel pipette, mixing each wash and removing the ethanol before the next wash.

substeps.instruction: Add 80 % ethanol to the bead pellet
Repeat the wash a second time

steps.title: Air‑dry bead pellets
steps.instruction: Allow the bead pellets to air‑dry on‑deck until no visible ethanol remains.

steps.title: Disengage magnets for elution
steps.instruction: Release the magnets to resuspend the beads in preparation for elution.

steps.title: Add TE and resuspend
steps.instruction: Add 0.1X TE buffer to each well with the P300 multi‑channel pipette and mix to fully resuspend the beads.

steps.title: Engage magnets to pellet
steps.instruction: Engage the magnets again to pellet the beads after resuspension.

steps.title: Recover and recombine eluates
steps.instruction: Using the P300 multi‑channel pipette, collect the eluate from both left and right sides of the plate and combine them into the designated output plate.
